description: This file defines an enum 'LaunchdManager' that manages launching and stopping a service called 'OpenClaw' using the launchctl command-line tool on macOS. It contains methods to start and stop the service by constructing commands with user-specific labels.

classes.name: LaunchdManager
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to start and stop the 'OpenClaw' service via launchctl.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: A private static method that executes the 'launchctl' command with specified arguments to manage launch agents.

methods.name: startOpenClaw
methods.description: Public static method that constructs a user-specific launchd label and uses 'launchctl' to start the service.

methods.name: stopOpenClaw
methods.description: Public static method that constructs a user-specific launchd label and uses 'launchctl' to stop the service.
